note: The Table: Poise hosts a dinner. Each player gets a secret mission, everyone just talks, then the reveal. Missions are harmless social dares: no drinking, no lying that could hurt someone, nothing at anyone's expense. 'bold' ones only appear in Unfiltered.

missions.text: Get two people to agree on a trip together without naming the place first.
Say the word “allegedly” three times, naturally.
Turn three different topics back to boats.
Get someone to show you a photo on their phone without asking to see one.
Find out two people's star signs without asking about birthdays.
Give every person here one specific compliment. No repeats, no “nice shirt”.
Get someone to say “that's a great question”.
Learn one thing about each person that nobody else here knew.
Get the person on your left to talk about their first job for a full minute.
Speak only in questions for a full minute without anyone noticing.
Start a debate about whether a hot dog is a sandwich, then stay perfectly neutral.
Get two people to swap seats or places.
Convince someone that octopuses have three hearts. (They do. Make them doubt you anyway, then prove it.)
Make the quietest person here laugh out loud.
Get the group to agree on a dish, a song or a plan you secretly picked, without suggesting it first.
Use the same hand gesture every time someone says your name.
Get someone to repeat back a word you just made up.
Tell a true story about yourself that gets an “no way”.
Get someone to ask you a question about yourself. Don't prompt it.
Agree enthusiastically with the next three opinions you hear, even the bad ones.
Find out what everyone here would order for their last meal.
Get someone to say the name of a city you've never been to.
Get the table to make a toast. Don't propose it yourself.
Introduce a new nickname for someone here and get one other person to use it.
Mention the weather four times without anyone pointing it out.
Get two people to discover they have something unexpected in common.
Name-drop someone you have never met and make it believable. Confess at the reveal.
Get someone to stand up for any reason.
Steer the conversation to everyone's most useless talent.
Finish someone's sentence correctly, twice.
Get someone to tell their worst date story.
Get someone to rate their own rizz out of ten, out loud.
Convince someone you used to be a competitive ballroom dancer. Confess at the reveal.
Get someone to admit their daily screen time.
Get the group to plan a trip you all know will never happen, down to the dates.
Get someone to read out the last text they sent. With their permission.
Find out who here has the most chaotic ex story, without asking for ex stories.
Get two people to argue, playfully, about whose aura is stronger.
Get someone to do their best impression of anyone, live.
Get someone to say “that's so true” about something completely made up.
Get the table to vote on something important you invented (a dress code for next time, a group name).
Get someone to tell you their most irrational fear.
